scenes: Ten heatwaves that changed what came next.

From Odisha in 1998, which taught a state to plan, | to Ahmedabad in 2010, behind South Asia’s first city heat plan, | to 2015, the region’s deadliest recent heatwave, | and Asia’s hottest April, in 2024, when schools shut from Dhaka to Manila.
Recorded deaths are a floor, not a total: | many heat deaths are never counted as heat deaths.
And after each one, something changed: new plans, new warnings, new rules.
Learn from the last heatwave before the next.
